+from pathlib import Path

+           THEN 'Night' ELSE 'Day' END AS period
+    FROM read_parquet('data/crashes.parquet')
+""")

+    SELECT datediff('day', min(crash_date), max(crash_date)) + 1
+    FROM crashes
+""").fetchone()[0]

+    SELECT period,
+           count(*) AS crashes,
+           count(*) FILTER (WHERE coalesce(number_of_persons_injured, 0)
+                                  + coalesce(number_of_persons_killed, 0) > 0)
+             AS injury_or_fatal_crashes,
+           count(*) FILTER (WHERE coalesce(number_of_persons_killed, 0) > 0)
+             AS fatal_crashes,
+           sum(coalesce(number_of_persons_injured, 0)) AS persons_injured,
+           sum(coalesce(number_of_persons_killed, 0)) AS persons_killed
+    FROM crashes
+    GROUP BY period
+""").df().set_index("period")
+
+periods = ["Day", "Night"]
+hours_per_day = {"Day": 14, "Night": 10}
+base = pd.DataFrame({
+    "period": periods,
+    "crashes": [int(data.loc[p, "crashes"]) for p in periods],
+    "hours_per_day": [hours_per_day[p] for p in periods],
+})
+base["calendar_days"] = days
+base["clock_hours_observed"] = base["hours_per_day"] * days

+    table[metric_column] = table["crashes_with_outcome"] / table["crashes"]
+    table["percent"] = 100 * table[metric_column]
+    table.to_csv(OUT / f"values_{option}.csv", index=False, float_format="%.8f")

+colors = {"Day": "#2878B5", "Night": "#E07A36"}
+

+bars = ax.bar(base["period"], base["crashes_per_clock_hour"],
+              color=[colors[p] for p in base["period"]], width=0.58)
+ax.set_title("Fewer reported crashes per clock hour at night", loc="left", weight="bold", pad=26)
+ax.text(0, 1.015, "NYC police-reported crashes · 8pm–5:59am vs 6am–7:59pm",
+        transform=ax.transAxes, fontsize=10, color="#555555")
+ax.set_ylabel("Crashes per clock hour across the dataset")
+ax.set_ylim(0, max(base["crashes_per_clock_hour"]) * 1.25)
+ax.spines[["top", "right"]].set_visible(False)
+ax.grid(axis="y", color="#dddddd", linewidth=0.7)
+ax.set_axisbelow(True)

+            ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=10)

+         fontsize=8, color="#555555")

+plt.close(fig)
+

+]

+    ax.set_ylabel("Percent of reported crashes")
+    ax.set_ylim(0, max(table["percent"]) * 1.38)
